description: Configure VSCode to recognize .tpl template files as HTML for syntax highlighting. The workspace at /home/ga/workspace/template_project contains .tpl files currently showing no syntax highlighting (treated as plain text). Add a file association in VSCode settings to map *.tpl files to the html language mode. You can: (1) Open Settings (Ctrl+,) > search 'files associations' > Add Item > pattern '*.tpl' mapped to 'html', OR (2) Command Palette (Ctrl+Shift+P) > 'Preferences: Open Settings (JSON)' > add to files.associations: '"*.tpl": "html"'. The setting key is 'files.associations' (plural), pattern is '*.tpl' (with asterisk), and language ID is 'html' (lowercase). After configuring, you can open templates/home.tpl to verify syntax highlighting appears. Save settings to persist the change.
